title: Status Model
description: Canonical trust and lifecycle status definitions for all knowledge graph objects. All v96 legacy entities are interpreted as 'legacy_canonical' by default — no bulk annotation required.

legacy_canonical.label: Legacy Canonical
legacy_canonical.description: Content inherited from grc20-these-mael-rolland-v96.json. Assumed valid as a scholarly baseline. Not individually reviewed under the new evidence framework. Default interpretation for all v96 entities and relations.

raw.label: Raw
raw.description: Extracted or imported from source material. Not yet processed, normalized, or linked to the graph.

extracted.label: Extracted
extracted.description: Processed from raw material. Normalized (deduplication, name resolution). Not yet linked to graph entities.

linked.label: Linked
linked.description: Connected to at least one graph entity or section. Relations established but not yet validated.

needs_review.label: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Flagged for human or agent review. May have inconsistencies, missing fields, or uncertain evidence.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: Explicitly reviewed and confirmed by a human or qualified agent review. Evidence has been verified.

contested.label: Contested
contested.description: Has unresolved alternative interpretations, conflicting sources, or documented disagreement. Visible in public UI with caveat.

published.label: Published
published.description: Included in a public static export snapshot (public/exports/). Visible to public without qualification.

deprecated.label: Deprecated
deprecated.description: Superseded by a newer version, merged into another entity, or withdrawn. Retained for lineage. Not included in exports.

evidence_status_mapping.note: The existing 'evidenceStatus' attribute on SourceQuote entities maps approximately to these statuses. Mapping is for reference; no bulk rewrite is performed.

applies_to_objects.graph_entity: Status on an entity in the GRC-20 canonical graph
applies_to_objects.graph_relation: Status on a relation in the GRC-20 canonical graph
applies_to_objects.evidence: Status on a SourceQuote or working evidence object
applies_to_objects.claim: Status on a workspace Claim object
applies_to_objects.narrative: Status on a NarrativePreset or NarrativeStep
